alyssa_cs: FYI team — draft for affected onboarding tenants. trying to keep it concise and non-technical. PTAL before i send in 30m.

alyssa_cs: Hi <customer name>,

We’re reaching out about a disruption to onboarding imports that occurred earlier today. Some customers experienced partial write failures and slower-than-expected indexing; we identified and fixed the root cause and are running a targeted re-index for affected tenants.

What we’re doing now:
• Full re-index for affected tenants (started)
• Manual verification of 5 sample documents per tenant
• Priority queue for any failed imports submitted in the last 24h

What this means for you:
• You may see a small delay in search/embeddings results for recently uploaded data (expected < 2 hours for most tenants)
• No customer data was exposed or deleted

Compensation and support:
• We’ll apply a one-time 10% service credit for affected onboarding windows
• We’re offering a dedicated 1:1 enablement session to help finish any outstanding index/ingest work

If you want us to prioritize your tenant, reply to this message and we’ll escalate. We apologize for the disruption and appreciate your patience.

Best,
Alyssa on behalf of Redwood Inference Ops & CS

marc_ae: i like the tone. a couple small asks: add a line that points to the internal rca link for transparency (customer-safe language) and confirm the credit mechanics (applied to next invoice).

devon_re: +1. Also i'd soften the expected time — maybe "expected resolution for most tenants within 2 hours; some may take up to 6 hours during reprocessing." avoids surprises.

alyssa_cs: good call. updating. new draft below — please check only the bracketed placeholders and the compensation line.

alyssa_cs: Hi <customer name>,

We’re writing about a disruption to onboarding imports that affected a subset of tenants earlier today. Some recent uploads experienced partial indexing delays; our team diagnosed the issue, deployed a fix, and started a targeted re-index for impacted tenants.

What we’re doing now:
• Running tenant-specific re-index jobs (in progress)
• Verifying a sample of ingested documents for accuracy
• Offering a priority retry for uploads sent in the last 24 hours

What this means for you:
• You may notice delayed or incomplete search/embedding results for recent uploads. Most tenants will be fully caught up within ~2 hours; a small number may take up to 6 hours depending on dataset size.
• No customer data was deleted or exposed.

Compensation and next steps:
• A one-time 10% credit will be applied to your next invoice for the affected onboarding period.
• If you’d like expedited handling, reply with "PRIORITIZE" and we’ll schedule a 1:1 enablement session and escalate your tenant.

We’ve also prepared a short, customer-friendly summary of our internal postmortem which you can request; please let us know if you want it.

We’re sorry for the disruption — we’re committed to making this right.

Best,
Alyssa (Customer Success)

jordan_vm: wording looks great. suggest we add a single-line FAQ at bottom: "How do I know if I was affected?" -> "If you saw errors on upload or missing results, reply and we’ll confirm."

sam_support: +1 on FAQ. also suggest adding a support link and hours: "Support: support@redwood.ai or slack #support (9am–6pm PT)"

alyssa_cs: added FAQ and contact. final draft below — will send at :30 after giving legal a 10-min look.

marc_ae: legal asked to remove the exact credit percentage from the draft (they want to confirm billing). can we change to "a one-time credit will be issued" and handle details in the follow-up email after billing confirms?

alyssa_cs: understood — switching now.

alyssa_cs: final-final: replaced credit line with "a one-time credit will be issued; billing will follow up with details." sending now.

ops_bot: Incident #INC-2026-118 resolved at 2026-03-23T14:05:23Z. Remediation deployed: reindex-worker-retry-fix v2.1.

devon_re: thanks all. can someone create a short internal postmortem (ops -> eng-runtime) with root cause + mitigation notes? i'll own the customer follow-ups and capture feedback.

alyssa_cs: will create the internal pm and tag eng-runtime. scheduling office-hours invite for prioritized customers. thanks!
